newsitem.title: USA: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 105.5 Dec 13 week.
newsitem.headline: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 105.5 Dec 13 week.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) weekly future inflation gauge (FIG) fell to 105.5 in the week ended December 13 from a revised 106.1 the previous week, ECRI said.

Among the monthly components, the growth rate of import prices fell slightly, ECRI said. In addition, it said weekly components, such as the growth rates of real estate loans and industrial materials prices, also declined.
"The Fig is clearly not on the rise, but despite its latest decline, it is still almost a point above summer lows," ECRI said.
